external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal with vendor-issued credentials.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal and pushes a nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: supplier portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and decide on it.
processes.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
processes.notes: The vendor's datasheet says the platform is secure by design, uses enterprise-grade encryption throughout, and that all access is fully authenticated and audited.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: A service in our cloud account that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: vendor's platform
data_stores.description: The vendor-hosted platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in our cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract as a CSV file.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The supplier database in our cloud account where the supplier master service writes extracted records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: supplier uploads to supplier portal
data_flows.description: Supplier uploads compliance paperwork to the supplier portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' own staff.

data_flows.name: category manager reviews supplier portal
data_flows.description: Category managers access uploaded paperwork through the supplier portal and approve or reject it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions.

data_flows.name: supplier portal stores documents in vendor's platform
data_flows.description: The supplier portal stores supplier compliance documents in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' own staff.

data_flows.name: vendor pushes nightly extract to landing bucket
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says the extract is encrypted end to end, while the landing-bucket runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is. These are conflicting positive claims.

data_flows.name: supplier master service loads landing bucket
data_flows.description: The supplier master service reads the nightly supplier data extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: supplier master service writes supplier database
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: suppliers
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by suppliers, outside the system's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

trust_boundaries.name: vendor's platform
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting zone containing the SaaS portal and its document platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud-account zone containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier data stored in the vendor's platform is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details; disclosure of these personal and business records could harm people or the business.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier data stored in the landing bucket is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket receives a supplier data extract containing supplier records and staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier records stored in the supplier database are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The supplier database receives supplier records from the extract, which includes contact details for suppliers' staff.
